hypothesis: One 256-thread block processes each row, using warp shuffle reduction and eight shared warp totals; the final normalization and FP16 store are performed in float32-compatible arithmetic.
semantics: For each row, accumulate float(__half x)^2, divide by hidden_size, add epsilon, apply rsqrtf, multiply float x and float weight, then round to FP16.
specialization: The implementation supports arbitrary positive hidden_size; official H=1024 uses four warps per row.
constraints: Uses only the supplied CUDA stream.
Does not allocate memory or change the ABI.
Does not implement residual, dropout, TE, collective, or backward logic.
unverified: Compilation and numerical equivalence were not run per request.
Performance was not benchmarked per request.
